description: Fetch a Google Docs document's title and plain-text body content. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Fetch an existing Google Docs document by id and return its title plus the plain-text of its body (tables, images, and other non-paragraph structural elements are not included in body_text — only paragraph text runs). This is the read counterpart to docs_batch_update (which edits) and docs_export (which spills the fully-formatted document as pdf/docx/txt into a blob). Use docs_export instead when formatting, tables, or images must be preserved. Fails gsuite.not_found if the id does not exist.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with title and body_text (plain text of the document body).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the document's content briefly. body_text may contain sensitive personal or corporate writing — treat as sensitive.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch a Google Docs document's content.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id. gsuite.not_found: the document id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.not_found: verify the document id. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
